_doc: Clinic upgrade categories (ClinicManager). Each level is installed per clinic, uses one upgrade slot and is drawn as an overlay (data/clinic_overlays.json).

levels.name: Instrument tray
levels.text: A clean tray beside the table. +3% precision.

levels.name: Anaesthesia cart
levels.text: Gas, not a bottle of vodka. Less pain, fewer complications.

levels.name: Cautery arm
levels.text: Ceiling-mounted cautery. Less bleeding, faster work.

levels.name: Handheld scanner
levels.text: Wall-hooked scanner and charts. Hidden conditions show up more often.

levels.name: Wall vitals monitor
levels.text: Live vitals over the table. Better reveals, safer recoveries.

levels.name: Imaging panel
levels.text: Lattice-grade imaging. Neural load reads lower and truer.

levels.name: Door camera
levels.text: You see who's coming. Raids hurt less.

levels.name: Bars and maglock
levels.text: The door holds long enough to hide things.

levels.name: CCTV bank
levels.text: Four feeds of the corridor. Nobody surprises you.

levels.name: Contraband crates
levels.text: Locked crates for things that fell off trucks. One more offer in the Undermarket.

levels.name: Organ cooler
levels.text: Cold storage for wet goods. Better prices, wider stock.

levels.name: Encrypted relay
levels.text: A private line to the Undermarket's brokers. Riskier, richer.

levels.name: Coat hooks and kit
levels.text: Somewhere for an employee to hang a coat. +1 staff.

levels.name: Rota board
levels.text: Shifts on the wall. +1 staff, less burnout.

levels.name: Second workstation
levels.text: A second stool and lamp. +1 staff, +1 job a day, staff work better.

levels.name: Waiting chairs
levels.text: Two plastic chairs. People wait longer and tip better.

levels.name: Recovery cot
levels.text: Patients sleep it off here instead of in the alley.
